key.mercuriale.open_page: Open the hovered item's VkAnalyzer page
mercuriale.config.title: Mercuriale
mercuriale.config.hint: Scroll to browse · prices come from VkAnalyzer
mercuriale.config.enabled.tip: Item prices at the auction house and in player shops, from VkAnalyzer. On VikingCraft only. Turned off, nothing is downloaded or shown.
mercuriale.config.market.tip: The reference price of the VkAnalyzer item page: what the item sells for, or else what people ask for it, with the number of sales or listings behind it.
mercuriale.config.shops.tip: The cheapest place to buy it and the best place to sell it. Unrenamed items only: shops only know the material.
mercuriale.config.amount.tip: Per unit, multiplied by the hovered stack size, or both: a "Stack" line is then added below the unit prices.
mercuriale.config.bargains.tip: In the auction house menu, compares each listing's price (per unit) with the usual price: green when cheaper, red when dearer.
Regular expression on the window title. On VikingCraft: "Menu | Hotel des Ventes - 1/...".
Regular expression on the listing's lore, whose first group captures the lot price. On VikingCraft: "• Prix 15 000$".
mercuriale.config.container_value.tip: Above an open chest, barrel or shulker box, the value of its contents. The contents of shulker boxes stored inside are not counted.
mercuriale.config.server_menu_pattern.ti: Regular expression on the window title. Server menus (auction house, shops) are not containers: their value would mean nothing.
mercuriale.config.radar_values.tip: Under each item of the radar list, what your stock would bring in: sold to the shops that buy it back, or sold in your own shop slightly cheaper than the cheapest one. Without shops, its auction house value.
mercuriale.config.radar_values.requires: Inactive: needs Chest Radar 3.11 or later.
mercuriale.config.shop_undercut.tip: To estimate what your own shop would bring in: the cheapest seller's price, lowered by this percentage, times what you own.
mercuriale.config.server.tip: Prices only show when the server address contains this text. Empty: on every server.
mercuriale.config.url.tip: Downloaded in the background every five minutes, then kept on disk.
mercuriale.bargain.label: This listing
